The '''[[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]''' of the mysterious [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was suspected by many to be a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], either within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region, or within the [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]].<ref name="LoNH" />
